description: Consolidated palette and grid conventions across every asset family in the project. This file is the union of what each family actually uses — not every family uses every token; see usedBy below.

danger.role: prohibition/error state (red) — added for 05-Icons, reused since by 06-Privacy-Illustration

neutral.role: primary stroke/ink on dark backgrounds, or background on light variants

usedByNote: 06-Privacy-Illustration's own brief specifies exactly these 5 colors and omits 'warning' — that wasn't a color left out by mistake, it's what that brief's own palette section lists. 07-OpenGraph is the only illustration family whose brief explicitly calls for 'warning' as a general accent (not tied to any specific glyph) rather than reserving yellow for a status-only badge the way 05-Icons does.

favicon.note: no strokes — solid fills only, by design; see 08-Favicon/README.md

radius.note: defined in 02-Foundation/tokens/design-tokens.json; 05-Icons reuses the same 3 values at icon scale
